research_integration.google_lens: optional external handoff only; not required for HAWKEYE capture/OCR/search
research_integration.gemini_standard: PC-owned credential; selected non-sensitive keyframes only after owner enables cloud mode
research_integration.gemini_live: direct device WebSocket using one-use short-lived token minted by KRISHNA PC
research_integration.local_first: ML Kit object/OCR/barcode/pose/face-presence/subject segmentation/language ID/translation remain available without Gemini after required local model downloads
research_integration.translation: ML Kit on-device translation; dynamic language models download on Wi-Fi and no Gemini API key is required
research_integration.gestures: MediaPipe Gesture Recognizer runs on-device with bundled hand/gesture model; pose-based hand raise remains a fallback
research_integration.spatial: Phone IMU/orientation metadata is attached to curated keyframes for BHOOMIPUTRA/photogrammetry correlation; it is not treated as SLAM, depth, or survey-grade pose by itself
research_integration.learning_verification: Distilled HAWKEYE candidates can run through Rishi Live -> Garuda -> Gautama -> Gyan proposal gate without raw-media transfer; automatic model escalation remains local-only
research_integration.openrouter: KRISHNA PC brokers credentials; HAWKEYE selected non-sensitive keyframes use a live zero-cost vision model chosen by role preference or dynamic ranking.
research_integration.free_cloud_reviews: Sanitized HAWKEYE text summaries may be reviewed by verified Cloudflare Workers AI and configured free_only text gateways such as Groq/Mistral; raw camera frames are not sent to text-only providers.
research_integration.mobile_qwen: disabled; no Qwen model is hosted on the phone. KRISHNA PC assigns Qwen by role: qwen3.5:4b general/fast vision, qwen2.5-coder:7b coding, qwen2.5vl:7b detailed HAWKEYE vision.
research_integration.pc_offload: Private/heavy HAWKEYE inference stays on KRISHNA PC; approved non-sensitive selected frames may use verified-free cloud to reduce PC load.
research_integration.pc_finding_sync: Distilled HAWKEYE cloud findings are written to the PC live-session ledger and Learning Observer with provider/model/reviewer provenance; raw keyframes are not required for this finding handoff.
research_integration.pc_compute_relief: When a cloud finding is already recorded, curated evidence sync stores the bounded evidence but skips duplicate PC vision/BRAHMA intake unless explicit heavy escalation is requested.
research_integration.private_transport: First enrollment uses authenticated LAN discovery; after approval the paired phone learns the current private-overlay Core URL. Raw media sync requires unmetered transport plus fresh same-LAN discovery proof.
research_integration.large_media_sync: Resumable 512 KiB chunks to the E-drive Hawkeye inbox; PC SHA-256 verification and atomic promotion are required before mobile sync state advances.

model_policy.mobile_cloud_credentials: PC-owned or short-lived device token only
